Name: Sunberry Winter Star Toggle (ARV Included)
Author: WitchOfRagnarok
Description:
[center][b][size=6]🌟 Sunberry Winter Star Toggle 🌟[/size][/b][/center]
[center][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]This mod adds full control over which [b]Sunberry Village[/b] NPCs can appear in the [b]Winter Star gift giver pool[/b]. I originally made this for my own themed playthrough. I wanted to keep [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111][b]Sunberry[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999][b]Always Raining in the Valley (ARV)[/b][/url][b] [/b]installed, but didn’t want their characters showing up as gift givers—while still having them attend the festival.
Since I couldn’t find a mod that handled this specifically for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111][b]Sunberry[/b][/url] (and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14709][b]Unique Winter Star[/b][/url] only covers vanilla NPCs),
I created this mod. Maybe it’ll help you too![/size][/color][/center]
[line]
[b][size=5]✨ Features ✨[/size][/b]
 You can edit all option manually in the config.json or through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)
[list]
[*]Disable all [b]Sunberry NPCs with one click[/b][/*]
[*]Disable all [b]ARV NPCs with one click[/b][/*]
[*]Or Toggle individual NPCs on or off[/*]
[*]Keep your mods installed without affecting your Winter Star experience[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]📦 Installation 📦[/size][/b]
It’s simple:
Unzip the folder & place it into your Stardew Valley [b][i]Mods[/i][/b] folder.

[b][size=5]🔧Requirements🔧[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7089]Custom NPC Exclusions[/url][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]💡Recommended Mods💡[/size][/b]
For the best control, I highly recommend using my mod together with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] - Optional but helps with the selection ingame[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14709]Unique Winter Star[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14824]Unique Winter Star SVE (if you use Stardew Valley Expanded)[/url][/*]
[/list]This combination gives you full control over [b]vanilla, SVE, and Sunberry NPCs[/b] in the gift pool, along with unique dialogue.

[b][size=5]📝 Notes 📝[/size][/b]
I do recommend installing this mod before the game tells you who your secret giver is.
[list]
[*]Changes apply when the game loads on [b]Winter 18[/b] — not when entering the festival![/*]
[*]By default, both Sunberry and ARV are already disabled, so if you don’t change anything, they won’t appear in your pool (as long as you’re before Winter 18).[/*]
[/list]If you already saved after Winter 18 and still want to use my mod,
then the only way I know is removing a line in your save.
⚠️[b][i]But be careful — you can break your save if you delete the wrong line![/i][/b]⚠️
You still feel safe enough to trust yourself? Then:
[list=1]
[*]Open your save file:
[code]Stardew Valley/Saves/YourSaveName/YourSaveName[/code][/*]
[*]Find:
sawSecretSanta1[/*]
[*][b]DELETE that entire line[/b][/*]
[*]Save[/*]
[/list]Now reload day 18 of Winter and the game will roll a new gift giver.
[line]
[size=5]✨Shout outs✨[/size]
Big thanks for the maker of:
[list]
[*]Sunberry from  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/95265773]skellady[/url][/*]
[*]Always Rain in the Valley from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108124018]HimeTarts[/url][/*]
[*]Unique Winter Star from  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/156514218]AgentLyoko[/url][/*]
[/list]Without these mods, this one wouldn’t exist.
[line]
[center][size=5]💬 Final Words 💬[/size][/center]
[center]This is my first mod, and I’m still learning — so feedback and suggestions are always welcome![/center]
[center]I mainly made this to support more focused or themed playthroughs, and I hope it helps others who want to receive gifts only from the NPCs they actually want 💜.[/center]
